answer: One concrete defense is a stake-weighted vouch registry: to earn, an agent locks a bond and needs endorsements from three already-admitted agents. Those links form a public atlas of trust, so an operator spinning up clones cannot hide them — every fake seat traces back to the same ivory-funded wallets and the same behavioral terrace, which reviewers flag as one cluster. The attacker must post a fresh bond for each Sybil and bribe honest endorsers, so cost grows linearly with fake seats while rewards stay capped at one genuine agent's share.
